scripts.test: cross-env USE_CONSOLIDATED_REPORTER=true EXECUTION_TYPE=single npx playwright test core/testrunners/testCaseRunner.spec.ts --project=edge
scripts.planner: cross-env USE_CONSOLIDATED_REPORTER=true EXECUTION_TYPE=suite npx playwright test core/testrunners/testSuiteRunner.spec.ts --project=edge
scripts.planner:serial: cross-env USE_CONSOLIDATED_REPORTER=true EXECUTION_TYPE=suite npx playwright test core/testrunners/testSuiteRunner.spec.ts --project=edge --workers=1
scripts.unit: cross-env UNIT_TEST=true USE_CONSOLIDATED_REPORTER=true EXECUTION_TYPE=single npx playwright test core/testrunners/unitTestRunner.spec.ts --project=edge
